description: The grouped bar chart illustrates F1 Score performance (in percent) across multiple datasets for MADLLM and three ablated variants. The horizontal axis contains the categorical variable “Dataset,” listing SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, MSL, and WADI from left to right, while the vertical axis is labeled “F1 Score (%)” on a linear scale spanning roughly 60 to 100 with tick marks at 60, 70, 80, 90, and 100. For each dataset, four adjacent bars are shown and color-coded by the legend: MADLLM (green), MADLLM w/o prompt pool (blue), MADLLM w/o feature embedding (purple), and MADLLM w/o skip embedding (orange). Approximate bar heights are: SMD—green ~93, purple ~91, blue ~92, orange ~92; PSM—green ~97, purple ~96, blue ~77, orange ~95; SWaT—green ~91, purple ~90, blue ~83, orange ~85; SMAP—green ~93, purple ~69, blue ~69, orange ~67; MSL—green ~87, purple ~85, blue ~69, orange ~85; WADI—green ~74, purple ~62, blue ~64, orange ~68. The bars are grouped by dataset rather than sorted by value, and there are no visible annotations, outlines, or other emphasis beyond the consistent color scheme and legend.
